items.summary: Force all primary action buttons across the entire app (including 'Sign In', 'Place Order', 'Place Recharge Order', 'Add to Cart', 'Checkout', and any other CTA buttons) to use a solid #0056b3 background with bold white (#ffffff) text. Override any conflicting Tailwind utility classes or CSS custom properties that are currently rendering buttons with white or near-white backgrounds.

Fix the Header component so that the 'Logout' and 'Cart' (with item count badge) buttons are clearly visible against the header background. Ensure these buttons have sufficient color contrast — use #0056b3 fill or a visually distinct outlined style with white/dark text so they are never invisible.

Restore the Sign-In page (Internet Identity login screen) so that all buttons — including the 'Sign In' / 'Login' button — are NOT white. Apply the same #0056b3 solid background with white bold text. Ensure the button is clearly clickable and visually prominent on the page.

Fix the category filter buttons in the CategoryFilter component so they are rendered with a visible background and legible label text. Selected/active category buttons should use #0056b3 with white text; unselected buttons should use a light gray background with dark text — ensuring none are invisible.

Audit and fix the global CSS custom properties and Tailwind theme in frontend/src/index.css and frontend/tailwind.config.js to ensure that no --primary, --background, or button-related CSS variables resolve to white or near-white values that cause buttons to disappear. Set --primary to #0056b3 and --primary-foreground to #ffffff in the light theme token definitions.
